results.content: Trump’s slide in the polls in recent weeks could signify good news for Democrats ahead of November’s midterm elections. In the newest Economist/YouGov poll, Democrats hold an 8-point lead over the GOP in a generic congressional ballot.
results.title: Trump's approval rating hits yet another record low in latest poll

results.content:
A survey from YouGov/Economist released on Tuesday shows that in a generic congressional vote, 36 percent of U.S. adults would pick the Democratic candidate compared to 31 percent who would pick the Republican candidate. One percent said other, eight percent said not sure and 23 percent said they would not vote.

The poll surveyed 1,592 U.S. adults from August 28-31 and had a margin of error of 3.5 percent. ## Polling averages update

All numbers are as of 1:00 PM Eastern on Aug. 14, 2026.

### 2026 U.S. House generic ballot

The Democratic margin in the 2026 U.S. House generic ballot rounded to 6 percentage points this week. Both Democrats and Republicans saw some improvement in their numbers, with Democrats increasing from 49 last week to 49.4 this week, and Republicans increasing from 42.5 to 43.3.
